'''Capitol Square''' was a region in the western part of the [[Governmental Sector|Government District]] in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].
